cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

mechanism: A corrects its former hospitality pupil ordinary table manners with mounting anxiety while treating a visiting dragon as entirely unremarkable.
confusable: Not general fussiness or fear of the creature: concern increases only about crumbs, enough napkins, and visible paper at the good table.
comparison: Social propriety during tea versus protecting polished furniture in a move.
seedUse: D165 dragon/three mouths/napkins/paper; S05 pupil table-setting correction.
